findings.evidence: SDKExtraction.collect loops `while True` checking processing_status and sleeps 30s with no maximum poll count or deadline; a batch that never reports `ended` makes the operator CLI hang indefinitely (only Ctrl-C stops it). Consider a bounded wait converted to a failed report.
findings.title: SDK batch polling loop has no time/attempt bound

findings.evidence: execute maps any RunNotFound from pipeline.report/resume/invalidate to a code-2 'run_not_found' refusal; metadata in the intermediate backup proof test... specifically, a RunNotFound raised from internal DB reads other than the existence check would be reported as a typed run-not-found refusal. Know
findings.title: Broad RunNotFound catch can mislabel internal absences as run_not_found

findings.evidence: Parser.error is overridden, but argparse's --help raises SystemExit, which is a BaseException and escapes both the inner try and `except Exception` in main_async, so help exits 0 printing usage text and no report. Harmless, but docs say every outcome prints the report.
findings.title: --help bypasses the 'every outcome prints the report' contract

findings.evidence: Other Settings fields use explicit _brain_alias(...) helper aliases while the two new booleans have none; they bind by field name case-insensitively, which likely matches BRAIN_KNOWLEDGE_LIFECYCLE_*, but if the settings source configures a prefix or forbids name-based lookup differently than assumed
findings.title: New lifecycle settings rely on default env-name binding, unlike aliased siblings
